ei.title: The Myth of the Tongue Map
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: The tongue was mapped into separate areas where certain tastes were registered: sweetness at the tip, sourness on the sides, and bitterness at the back of the mouth. Research in the 1980s and 1990s, however, demonstrated that the "tongue map" explanation of how we taste was, in fact, totally wrong. As it turns out, the map was a misinterpretation and mistranslation of research conducted in Germany at the turn of the twentieth century. Today, leading taste researchers believe that taste buds are not grouped according to specialty. Sweetness, saltiness, bitterness, and sourness can be tasted everywhere in the mouth, although they may be perceived at a little different intensities at different sites. Moreover, the mechanism at work is not place, but time. It's not that you taste sweetness at the tip of your tongue, but rather that you register that perception first.

❌ ② (A) 회전 — (B) 전환기: (A)의 turn은 기다리는 차례이지 회전이 아님
❌ ③ (A) 차례 — (B) 방향 전환: (B)의 turn은 방향 전환이 아닌 시기(전환기)
❌ ④ (A) 모퉁이 — (B) 차례: (A)는 모퉁이가 아닌 차례, (B)는 차례가 아닌 전환기
det.tip: turn: ① 차례/순서(wait for your turn) ② (시기의) 전환기(at the turn of the century) ③ 회전 ④ 방향 전환

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a failure to understand the meaning of something correctly"

det.korean: misinterpretation=잘못된 해석/오해 (무언가의 의미를 올바르게 이해하지 못함)
det.analysis:
❌ ① specialty(특성/전문성): 의미 오해와 무관
❌ ② mechanism(기제): 작동 방식으로 정의와 다름
❌ ③ intensity(강도): 세기로 정의와 무관
✅ ④ misinterpretation(잘못된 해석/오해): 무언가의 의미를 올바르게 이해하지 못하는 것으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
det.tip: misinterpretation = 오해/잘못된 해석. failure to understand correctly가 핵심

questions.passage: Today, leading taste researchers believe that taste buds are not __________ (group) according to specialty. Sweetness, saltiness, bitterness, and sourness can be tasted everywhere in the mouth.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'taste buds are not __________ according to specialty'에서 be동사 are 뒤에 수동태를 이루는 과거분사가 필요하다. '미뢰가 분류되는' 수동 의미이므로 동사 group을 과거분사 grouped로 바꾼다. group → grouped
det.tip: be + p.p.(수동태): are not grouped(분류되지 않는다)

questions.passage: As it turns out, the map was a misinterpretation and __________ (mistranslate) of research conducted in Germany. Today, leading taste researchers believe that taste buds are not grouped according to specialty.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: 관사 a + misinterpretation and __: 명사 misinterpretation과 병렬되는 명사 mistranslation
det.analysis: 'a misinterpretation and __________'에서 명사 misinterpretation과 and로 병렬되는 또 다른 명사가 필요하다. 동사 mistranslate(오역하다)를 명사 mistranslation(오역)으로 바꾼다. mistranslate → mistranslation
det.tip: mistranslate(동사: 오역하다) → mistranslation(명사: 오역). 명사 and 명사 병렬

questions.passage: The tongue was mapped into separate areas where certain tastes were registered: sweetness at the tip, sourness on the sides, and bitterness at the back of the mouth. Research in the 1980s and 1990s, however, demonstrated that the "tongue map" explanation of how we taste was, in fact, totally wrong. As it turns out, the map was a misinterpretation and mistranslation of research conducted in Germany at the turn of the twentieth century. Today, leading taste researchers believe that taste buds are not grouped __________. Sweetness, saltiness, bitterness, and sourness can be tasted everywhere in the mouth, although they may be perceived at a little different intensities at different sites. Moreover, the mechanism at work is not place, but time. It's not that you taste sweetness at the tip of your tongue, but rather that you register that perception first.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: according to specialty=특성에 따라 — 미뢰는 특정 맛 전담(특성)에 따라 분류되지 않는다
det.analysis:
❌ ① only on the tip of the tongue(혀끝에만): 미뢰의 위치가 아닌 분류 방식을 설명하는 맥락
✅ ② according to specialty(특성에 따라): 미뢰가 특정 맛 전담(특성)에 따라 묶이지 않는다는 맥락에 부합. 뒤 문장에서 모든 맛이 모든 곳에서 느껴진다고 뒷받침 ←정답
❌ ③ by their chemical structure(화학 구조에 따라): 본문에 없는 분류 기준
❌ ④ in a single central region(단일 중심 구역에): 분류 방식이 아닌 위치 설명으로 맥락과 다름
det.tip: taste buds are not grouped according to specialty — 미뢰는 특성(전담 맛)에 따라 묶이지 않는다

ch: only on the tip of the tongue

questions.passage: The tongue was mapped into separate areas where certain tastes were registered: sweetness at the tip, sourness on the sides, and bitterness at the back of the mouth. Research in the 1980s and 1990s, however, demonstrated that the "tongue map" explanation of how we taste was, in fact, totally wrong. As it turns out, the map was a misinterpretation and mistranslation of research conducted in Germany at the turn of the twentieth century. Today, leading taste researchers believe that taste buds are not grouped according to specialty. Sweetness, saltiness, bitterness, and sourness can be tasted everywhere in the mouth, although they may be perceived at a little different intensities at different sites. Moreover, the mechanism at work is not place, but time. It's not that you taste sweetness __________, but rather that you register that perception first.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: at the tip of your tongue=혀끝에서 — 단맛을 혀끝에서 느끼는 것이 아니라 그 인식을 먼저 등록한다는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① only after swallowing your food(음식을 삼킨 후에만): 삼킴 여부는 본문과 무관
❌ ② across your entire body at once(온몸에서 한꺼번에): 맛은 몸이 아닌 입에서 느껴짐
✅ ③ at the tip of your tongue(혀끝에서): 'It's not that you taste sweetness at the tip of your tongue, but rather that you register that perception first'에서 단맛을 혀끝에서 느낀다는 통념을 반박하는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ through your sense of smell(후각을 통해): 본문은 미각의 기제를 다루며 후각은 언급되지 않음
det.tip: not that you taste sweetness at the tip of your tongue — 혀끝에서 단맛을 느끼는 것이 아니라

ch: across your entire body at once
at the tip of your tongue
